protocol.name: ragtruth_corrected_stats_v1
protocol.group_meaning: RAGTruth source_id. The frozen tables contain one claim from each available generator per source, about six claims per question.
protocol.resample_method: percentile bootstrap, numpy quantile linear, alpha=0.05
protocol.point_estimate: unweighted mean of the three seed-level statistics after 4-decimal rounding
protocol.across_seed_dispersion: sample standard deviation across seeds (ddof=1); not a confidence interval
protocol.paired_comparison: per-seed 95% paired question-grouped percentile bootstrap interval for delta AUROC
protocol.bootstrap_fraction: bootstrap fraction of resamples with delta > 0; not a p-value
protocol.formal_p_value: not computed; three seeds and 27 test questions do not support one here
protocol.split: unchanged grouped_split by question_id; stratify flag left untouched
protocol.thresholds: Stage 4 validation-tuned thresholds reloaded; not retuned
